hypotheses.claim: On cvrp_dev_hetero_24 (online bin packing with strict prefix-causal score_bin), a tighter-fit ScoreBin — score = capacity - (remaining - item), i.e. higher score for the smallest residual after placement — packs at least as few bins as the Worst-Fit default and materially reduces bin count on heterogeneous item sequences, because Best-Fit preserves large residuals for large items without lookahead. Tie-breaking by bin creation order must keep the rule a pure function of the strict prefix (no future items, no global re-sorting) so the 5-gate interface validator passes.

next_search_advice.direction: Replace the default Worst-Fit-style ScoreBin with a Best-Fit-style residual score: prefer the feasible open bin minimizing post-placement residual (equivalently maximizing fill), with deterministic tie-breaks on bin creation order and a bounded fallback to opening a new bin only when no feasible bin exists.
